reviewed_contracts.policy_selection: Uses fixed global and triple selections from policy-freeze.json. No subset search, training or retuning occurs.
reviewed_contracts.source_and_positions: Each successful route output must match its canonical source/checkpoint document exactly apart from routing settings, and settings must equal the frozen policy.
reviewed_contracts.canonical_attempts: First terminal source/route result. Incomplete stages reject outcome analysis. A failed source can supply only its explicit completed-layout checkpoint, with partial-reference disclosure.
reviewed_contracts.archive_publication: Successful candidate/reference geometry signatures are checked before result tables are written.
reviewed_contracts.scoped_oracles: Current scope has current default plus three frozen routes. Joint scope has three frozen layout defaults plus nine frozen alternatives. No extra development-only alternative is admitted.
reviewed_contracts.static_stable: Removes incidental edit metrics only in the scoring projection to reproduce static development source scoring; raw diagnostics remain intact.
reviewed_contracts.hard_gates: Status, frozen hard validity and required/source intent remain gates. A zero soft score cannot cover invalidity.
reviewed_contracts.timing: Observed route-only outcome is primary. Compile/checkpoint time plus route worker time is a labeled derived sensitivity; missing timing stays unknown and no new runtime hard gate is introduced.
reviewed_contracts.uncertainty: 2000 resamples of whole bases or whole families. Correlated profile/alternative rows stay inside clusters. Conditional soft intervals require both outcomes valid.
reviewed_contracts.specialists: Explicit current-specialist escape is retained for generic-engine-inapplicable cases; nominal engine labels are not credited as separate specialist solutions.
reviewed_contracts.authorization: The code requires --analyze and --allow-heldout-after-freeze for outcome mode, and the human/controller all-ready notice remains required before execution.
